name: Microwave Popcorn
note: Stop at 2 seconds between pops. The bag is lying to you.

name: Nachos, Fully Loaded
note: Cheese to chip ratio is a moral position. Choose wisely.

name: Cereal, Dry, By The Handful
note: Sanctioned. It is a movie, not a dinner party.

name: Ice Cream Straight From The Tub
note: One spoon per household. No bowls. No witnesses.

name: Pizza Rolls
note: Molten for the first eight minutes. Respect the cooldown.

name: Chips And Whatever Dip Survives
note: Double dipping is a felony in this jurisdiction.

name: Movie Theater Candy, Smuggled
note: You bought it at the grocery store. Nobody has to know.

name: Cheese And Crackers, Fancy Edition
note: Arrange on a board to unlock the sophisticated ending.

name: Leftovers, Cold, No Plate
note: The refrigerator door is the dining room now.

name: Trail Mix, M&Ms Removed First
note: You are the reason there are only raisins left.

name: Milkshake, Blender At Full Volume
note: Make it before the movie. This is not negotiable.

name: A Suspicious Amount Of Pickles
note: Crunch responsibly during the quiet scenes.

name: Toast. Just Toast.
note: Minimalism. The snack equivalent of a black turtleneck.

name: Frozen Grapes
note: Assuming somebody remembered to freeze them. Somebody did not.

name: Instant Ramen In A Mug
note: The seasoning packet is a full serving of the ocean.

name: Cookie Dough, Unbaked, Unrepentant
note: The label says don't. The label is not your supervisor.

name: Whatever The Kids Hid
note: Check the couch, the closet, and behind the cereal boxes.

name: Charcuterie Board Of Regret
note: You will finish assembling it during the credits.

name: Air. Nothing. Discipline.
note: Bold. You will crack in 25 minutes.

name: Second Dinner
note: The first dinner was a rehearsal and everyone knows it.
